Mooring Fees for the Coming Season

The harbour board set next season's mooring fees on Tuesday. Visiting boats pay by the night, and residents by the season, at last year's rate for the third year running.

A berth on the outer pontoon costs a little more than one inside the wall, because the pontoon is dredged every spring.
